script_text: This week, Uranus in Taurus detonates your Earthly security and forces Venus, your ruling planet, to confront Saturn. This is not small. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury squares Venus in your tenth house, so career and money clashes intensify, especially Tuesday, when the square is sharpest. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth house, sparking romantic luck and creative courage. Your lover may feel distant, but honest words rebuild intimacy. Midweek, the Moon opposes your natal Venus, a turning point that shifts love and values. Late week, Jupiter in Aries activates your seventh house, bringing intense but exciting relationship energy. Weekend, Mars in your second house urges bold financial moves, yet avoid impulsive spending. Your best day is Wednesday; your worst is Tuesday. Your finances need steady hands. Stay grounded. Weekly advice: set one non-negotiable boundary around shared resources. Follow for daily updates.
